exposure: Two groups: primiparous (G1, n=45) and multiparous (G2, n=56) women.
cohort: 101 pregnant women admitted for vaginal delivery of breech presentation.
finding: Parity was not a significant factor in the success of vaginal delivery for breech presentation.
mod_finding: Parity was not a significant factor in the success of vaginal delivery for breech presentation.
